Core balancenot measured

First touch unlocks local sound. Mute remains available; lower your phone volume before listening.

Sawtooth / crossing

A drag crosses the declared closed ring: sharp inward zigzags and short sawtooth clicks. This is a synthetic contract mismatch, not proof that a real physical layer was violated.

Wobble / ambiguity

A drag reverses within a layer or approaches a layer boundary: wavering paths and modulated tone. Rhythm is quantised into later loop steps, not a replay of finger timing.

Endpoint / unresolved

An unresolved endpoint produces a dashed screen fragment and seeds a silent step. It stays visibly unresolved; it is not forced into continuity or compensated with an invented sound.

Zero-data output contract

There is no gesture export, audio recording, identity capture, raw sensor archive or external network submission. In this local integration, only bounded aggregate rhythm descriptors can reach the same-origin parent shell; no contact or tilt samples leave this instrument. Clear, reset, hide the page or reload to stop and discard its outputs.

App-unretained sound is not guaranteed unrecordable. Another device, screenshot or operating-system capture can still record what you perceive.
